next_steps.action: The rail-voltage measurement showed meter OVERLOAD (OL) — the voltage exceeds the meter's selected range. This is NOT a normal reading. Either switch to a higher range, or the rail is genuinely overvoltage (a dangerous condition). Re-measure on a higher DC range before proceeding.

measure.what: Rail voltage on a higher range
measure.instrument: DMM DC volts, higher range (e.g. 1000 V)
measure.expected: A finite reading within the rail's nominal tolerance, OR a confirmed overvoltage.
measure.safety: Overvoltage rails can damage downstream ICs. Disconnect load if overvoltage is confirmed.

interpretations.then: Previous OL was a range error. Re-run diagnosis.
Regulation failure. Disconnect load. Suspect feedback divider open or controller dead.
